bridge.title: Browser bridge (online stores)
bridge.intro: A small script runs in your browser on the store's website: « Send to the online store » (Shopping page) opens the site and fills the basket with the online items of the list, your usual products first. Slot and payment stay manual.

voice.title: Voice assistants (Siri, Shortcuts…)
voice.intro: Say « Add milk and eggs to the shopping list »: each item lands in the list, in its aisle. It needs a « bridge » key of its own (it is good for nothing else).
voice.address: Address to call (POST, JSON { "text": "…" }, header Authorization: Bearer <key>)
voice.siriSteps:
Shortcuts app → + → add the action « Dictate Text ».
Add the action « Get Contents of URL »: the address above, method POST.
Headers: Authorization = Bearer followed by the key; Request body: JSON, field text = Dictated Text.
Name the shortcut « Shopping »: « Hey Siri, shopping » then say the items.
voice.others: Android: Tasker or HTTP Shortcuts with the same address. Google Keep, a Home Assistant to-do list or CalDAV tasks sync both ways: Settings → Connectors.

inbound.title: Receipts forwarding address
inbound.intro: An e-mail address of your own household: forward the mails of your stores to it (online orders, digital receipts, invoices), they land in the receipts of the Pantry page. Pantarr has no access to your mailbox.
inbound.renewText: The current address will stop working: put the new one in your forwarding filter. Useful against unwanted mails.
inbound.confirmText: Gmail asks to confirm the forwarding from {{account}}: type this code in Gmail, or click "Confirm".
inbound.gmail1: Gmail → gear → "See all settings" → "Forwarding and POP/IMAP" tab → "Add a forwarding address": paste the address above.
inbound.gmail2: Gmail sends a confirmation code to this address: it shows here within seconds. Type it in Gmail (or click "Confirm the forwarding"). Keep "Disable forwarding" selected: only the stores are forwarded.
inbound.gmail3: "Filters and Blocked Addresses" tab → "Create a new filter" → in "From", paste the list below → "Create filter".
inbound.gmail4: Tick "Forward it to" → pick your Pantarr address → "Create filter". Add a store to the list when you change.
inbound.outlook2: Condition "From": add the addresses (or names) of your stores.
inbound.outlook3: Action "Forward to": paste the Pantarr address → Save. (A work mailbox may forbid forwarding outside.)
inbound.other: With another mail service, or by hand
inbound.otherText: Most mail services have forwarding rules. Otherwise simply "Forward" a store's mail to the Pantarr address: the attachment or the mail's content is read.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Pantarr
onboarding.createText: A household gathers the people who share meals, recipes, stock and shopping.
onboarding.welcomeText: Pantarr plans the week's menus with your recipes and what you already have, then makes the shopping list. Here are the four everyday screens; then a few settings so that the first menus suit you (everything can be skipped and found later in Settings).
onboarding.feature.planningText: The week's menus proposed in one click, adjustable meal by meal.
onboarding.feature.shoppingText: Made from the menus minus your stock, sorted by aisle, sent to your drive.
onboarding.feature.pantryText: What you have at home, kept up to date by your receipts.
onboarding.feature.recipesText: Your recipes, imported from a site or written by hand, rated and starred.
onboarding.peopleText: Who eats at home? Give allergies and diets: the menus take them into account.
onboarding.mealsText: Your habits: meals eaten at home, favourite dishes, preparation time.
onboarding.recipesText: Menus are chosen among your recipes. To start right away, add our everyday recipes.
onboarding.shoppingText: Do you shop online? Install the browser extension to fill the basket from the list.
onboarding.receiptsText: Forward your grocery receipts or invoices by mail, or connect your mailbox: the stock updates itself.
onboarding.calendarText: Connect your calendar so that the menus skip the evenings you are away.
onboarding.doneText: Generate your first menus from the planning: the shopping list will follow.
onboarding.doneMember: Find the menus in the planning and the household's shared shopping list.
onboarding.later: Everything is in Settings, sorted by Meals, Shopping, Stock, Recipes and Household.

home.title: The week's menus and the shopping list, made for your family
home.subtitle: Pantarr plans the meals around who eats when, everyone's tastes and allergies, plans the leftovers, then prepares the shopping list and fills your online grocery basket. In 3 minutes a week.
home.trust: No credit card · hosted in Europe · no ads
home.trustCode: Invitation-only beta · hosted in Europe · no ads
home.trustClosed: Sign-ups are closed for now: have a look at the demo.
home.preview.title: Your week
home.step.menuText: Say who you are once. Every week, Pantarr plans the meals with your recipes, skipping the evenings you are away. Don't like a dish? Change it in one click.
home.step.listText: The ingredients of the meals, minus what you already have, sorted by aisle, shared with your partner and split between the store and the online basket.
home.step.driveText: The extension fills the basket of your online grocery store with the products you usually buy.
home.whyTitle: What changes compared with a recipe app
home.why.peopleText: Allergies, diets, children eating the lunch leftovers, a variant for one person: the menus take them into account.
home.why.leftoversText: A Sunday dish feeds Monday's lunch; nothing is forgotten in the fridge.
home.why.recipesText: Import them from your favourite sites or write your own; 50 everyday recipes are offered to start.
home.why.stockText: Forward your receipts by e-mail: Pantarr knows what you have and what will run out.
home.why.balanceText: Fish, pulses, vegetables at every meal: the week follows public health guidelines.
home.why.budgetText: Your spending read from your receipts, the estimated price of the list, cheaper menus if you wish.
home.privacy0: Hosted in Europe, no ads, no data sold.
home.privacy1: From your calendar, only busy slots are used, never the titles.
home.privacy2: Your mails are only read to find grocery receipts.
home.privacy3: Export and delete all your data in one click; free software (AGPL), installable at home.
home.planAccounts: up to {{count}} accounts in the household
home.planMenus: {{count}} menu proposals or changes a month
home.planAll: list, online basket, receipts, calendar, balance and budget
home.faq.storesText: French online grocery stores for the basket (E.Leclerc, Carrefour, Intermarché, Auchan, Courses U, Chronodrive, Monoprix); every store for the list and the receipts. You still pick the slot and pay on the store's site.
home.faq.phoneText: Yes: Pantarr installs like an app from the browser (Android and iPhone). Filling the online basket is done from a computer (Chrome, Edge or Firefox) for now.
home.faq.ai: Does an AI make the menus?
home.faq.aiText: Yes, an AI model plans the menus from your settings and your recipes. You stay in control: every meal can be changed, and allergies are checked on the ingredients. Always check the labels for a serious allergy.
home.faq.dataText: It is only used to prepare your menus and shopping. Allergies and diets are only used with your consent. See the privacy policy.
home.faq.cancel: Can I stop whenever I want?
home.faq.cancelText: Yes, no commitment. You can export then delete all your data from « My account ».
home.lastTitle: Try it on your next week

consent.title: Allergies and diets: your consent
consent.text: Allergies and diets (gluten-free, halal, vegetarian…) may reveal health or religious information. Pantarr only uses them to prepare suitable menus: they are sent to the AI service that plans the menus and checked against the ingredients, never for anything else. You can withdraw your consent at any time: they are then erased.
consent.accept: I agree that Pantarr uses the allergies and diets of the household's people to prepare the menus
consent.withdrawText: The allergies and diets of everyone in the household will be erased, and the menus will no longer take them into account.
